title: A reporter handed Meta's Muse his life for a week — it called his dental insurer and found duplicate subscriptions
titleZh: 记者把生活交给 Meta Muse 一周：它致电牙科保险公司，还查出两份重复订阅
summary: New York Times reporter Eli Tan spent a week delegating personal admin to Meta's Muse. The agent called his dental insurer Anthem Dental, gave the member number, answered security questions and navigated to a human representative. Separately, it found two duplicate subscriptions in his purchase history and refunded $44.99.
summaryZh: 《纽约时报》记者 Eli Tan 用一周时间把个人事务交给 Meta 的 Muse。该 Agent 致电他的牙科保险公司 Anthem Dental，报出会员号、回答安全问题并转接到人工代表。另外，它从他的消费记录中发现两份重复订阅，并退款 $44.99。
background: Insurance phone trees and forgotten subscriptions are the classic low-urgency admin that never gets done. The test was whether an agent could absorb that entire category of errand rather than just assist with it.
backgroundZh: 保险电话树和早已遗忘的订阅，是典型的「不紧急所以永远不做」的杂事。这次实测要回答的是：Agent 能否整类接手这类事务，而不只是打打下手。

actions.label: Phone call
actions.value: Called Anthem Dental, gave the member number, answered security questions

actions.label: Escalation
actions.value: Reached a human representative on the user's behalf

actions.label: Discovery
actions.value: Found two duplicate subscriptions in purchase history

outcome: According to the reporter, the experience was striking enough that he titled the piece 'I Gave My Life Over to Meta's A.I. Agent and Was Blown Away'.
outcomeZh: 据该记者自述，体验之强烈让他给文章起名「我把生活交给了 Meta 的 AI Agent，结果被震撼到了」。
caveat: This is one journalist's week-long personal test, not a measured evaluation. A widely circulated rewrite of this story renames the user 'Alex', moves him to New York, and adds a doctor list with Google Maps links and a next-day appointment — none of which appear in the original.
caveatZh: 这是一位记者为期一周的个人实测，并非量化评测。网络流传的改写版把用户改名为「Alex」、搬到纽约，并添加了「医生名单 + Google Maps 位置」和「次日拿到预约」等情节——这些在原文中均不存在。
keyFact: As of 22 September 2026, a New York Times reporter's week-long test of Meta's Muse recorded the agent calling his dental insurer, answering security questions and reaching a human representative, and separately finding duplicate subscriptions worth a $44.99 refund.
keyFactZh: 截至 2026 年 9 月 22 日，《纽约时报》记者对 Meta Muse 为期一周的实测记录显示：该 Agent 致电其牙科保险公司、回答安全问题并转接人工，另外还查出两份重复订阅、退款 $44.99。
